data_quality_audits.acceptance_rule: Fail if duplicate job_id after canonicalization
data_quality_audits.action: Run 2026-10-24 (Python): job_id unique across all 15,458 imported rows; LinkedIn exact duplicate ids kept with -dupN suffix and excluded.

LinkedIn: 171 duplicate rows flagged and excluded (29 exact + same company/title/description). Fliar: source already deduplicated per company+title+month; 4.0% of company+title groups repeat across months (kept, grouped for splitting).
LinkedIn: 17 rows under 200 chars and 17 non-English/unknown excluded. Fliar (12,958) and Headcount (1,000) have no descriptions by design, so only 2057 rows can feed NLP.

Fliar salaries are INR; period assumed annual (not stated). 245 rows have a single value (min blank). 475 rows have mid-point below Rs 1.5 lakh/yr (mostly internships) - plausible, not removed. No salary in LinkedIn rows.

data_quality_audits.method: Check dates parse and within source coverage
data_quality_audits.action: Fliar: all 12,958 posted_month values valid (2024-01 to 2026-06), but only month known. LinkedIn: posted_at is empty in 100% of rows; only scrape date (2026-04-30/05-01) available.

data_quality_audits.method: Share of extracted skills mapped to canonical taxonomy
data_quality_audits.action: 94.1% of 2057 eligible LinkedIn JDs have at least one extracted skill; mean 5.5 distinct skills per JD (dictionary_regex). Precision/recall unknown until 07_Gold_Labels is annotated.

data_quality_audits.method: Cohen's kappa or agreement rate between annotators
data_quality_audits.action: No human annotations yet. 07_Gold_Labels contains 991 candidate pairs ready for two annotators.
Run 2026-10-24: 0 duplicate groups span more than one split (Fliar and LinkedIn checked). Splits are group-based.

data_quality_audits.method: Counts by source, city, role, date and seniority
data_quality_audits.action: Fliar top cities: Bengaluru 2829, Hyderabad 1486, Mumbai 1479, Pune 971, Gurugram 844. LinkedIn top cities: Bengaluru 399, Mumbai 341, Hyderabad 324, Pune 177, Chennai 153. LinkedIn covers two scrape days only; Fliar sample is hash-selected by company. Neither is a representative sample of the Indian job market.
15.5% of eligible LinkedIn JDs share their first 300 characters with another eligible JD (same-company boilerplate/templates); keep in mind when counting skill demand.

limitations: Fliar BI salary data (12,958 rows) specifies INR amounts but salary period is assumed annual (median mid-point INR 10.2 lakh).
Job descriptions are only present in LinkedIn sample (2,057 eligible rows); Fliar BI and Headcount rows do not contain descriptions.
Candidate roles and extracted skills reflect historical posting samples and do not guarantee current employer hiring probability.
Simulations and quizzes are pedagogically calibrated assessments, clearly distinct from official employer technical screens.
